name: @pipeworx/mcp-hagstofa-is

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Navigate the database/subject tree. Root lists databases; sub-paths list folders (type "l") and tables (type "t", id ends in ".px").

path.description: Sub-path under the English PxWeb root (default empty = root). e.g. "Ibuar/mannfjoldi/1_yfirlit/yfirlit_mannfjolda"

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Table definition (dimensions, valid values). Path must include the ".px" table suffix.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Pull data from a table (path includes the ".px" suffix). body is a PxWeb query object. PxWeb limits request size — filter dimensions to keep the cell count small.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hagstofa-is forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hagstofa-is pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
